claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, N6-cyclopentyladenosine is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent; it is a potent A1 adenosine receptor agonist with no intrinsic cell-killing mechanism at achievable concentrations.
